name: Rugged Elder Leshy
desc:
A Leshy that grows in forests and wilds.
With only fragmentary sentience and no ability to speak, Leshies may appear to be the result of the Golden Realm's early experiments. Yet according to records, the truth is the opposite. Only after its artisans had almost fully mastered the authority over life did they create this race of fae.
Perhaps there is some true purpose within this that neither the fae nor humans of the present can fully understand.

customize.text:
One of the fae peoples of Snezhnaya. The exceptionally resilient ancient Leshy can root themselves into recovery and enhancement. However, when they are rooted, their hearts will be exposed. <color=#ffe14b>Attack the Leshy's heart</color> to disrupt its rooting.
Additionally, when the Leshy's rooting is disrupted, any Pyro affecting it will also deal a small amount of damage.
When affected by the Stellar Glimmer reaction while it's rooted, the Leshy's heart will become more exposed and easier to attack.

dropMaterial.name: Mora
dropMaterial.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

dropMaterial.name: Ethereal Glimmershard
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
These shards once coated the creature's body like crystalline scales. Upon falling away, they stripped themselves of all colors, shifting into something akin to the dusty dross of a moth's wings.

dropMaterial.name: Ethereal Crystal
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A shattered fragment of the crystalline scales that once grew upon the fae's body. Though it is now a mere empty shell, one can still sense the echo of the unique power that once dwelt within.

dropMaterial.name: Ethereal Crystalscale Stone
dropMaterial.desc:
The remains of a Snezhnayan fae left behind after battle.
A crystalline scale that once grew upon the fae's body. It is said that fae possessing a greater abundance of these scales command far greater power. Yet, none can say whether this magic truly originates from within their forms — merely channeled outward through the crystal chunks — or if the chunks themselves are the very vessels of their power.

dropMaterial.name: Hollow Root of Life
dropMaterial.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
With only a few crystals grown upon it, this branch holds little power and gives off a faint glow.

dropMaterial.name: Sprout Node of Life
dropMaterial.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch bearing a fair number of crystals. It feels heavy in the hand, and traces of vitality can still be felt within it even after it has broken away from the Leshy's body.

dropMaterial.name: Coiled Core of Life
dropMaterial.desc:
A branch dropped by a Leshy before it returned to silence.
A branch with a fully formed crystal core. It contains vitality that will not easily fade. If buried in the soil, it would likely grow into a new Leshy before long.
